title: Thunder project
description: A folder with a thunder.json is a Thunder project: it says which program is the entry point, which language it is written in and where its modules and C++ libraries are. Every key is optional.

name.description: The project's name, shown in the Thunder view.

entry.description: The program Run, Debug and Package work on when no Thunder file is open, relative to this file.

language.description: The natural language of the programs. A "// lang:" directive in a file always wins.

modulePaths.description: Directories searched for imported modules (thunderc -I), besides the importing file's own directory.

nativePaths.description: Directories searched for the C++ libraries of "import native" (thundervm --native-path).

display.description: Display plug-in that gives a graphics program its own window: sdl, win32 or text.

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the program; args() in module os returns them.

output.description: Where the bytecode goes. A directory takes the program's name with .thc; empty means beside the source.

package.description: Where "Package as an application" writes the executable.

maxSteps.description: Stop a program after this many instructions (0: no limit).
